The '''Dur-24 wrist laser''' was a portable [[wrist laser]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]].

The Dur-24 was comparable to a standard BlasTech [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] in terms of power, and had a range of fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used a Dur-24 wrist laser, mounted on his left wrist [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] directly above his [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[ZX miniature flame projector/Legends|ZX miniature flame projector]].
